reasoning: The icon shows stacked square frames containing the text 'PDF', representing PDF documents or batch operations on PDF files (merging, splitting, compressing, OCR). While many tasks mention a PDF only as the file format of an invoice, ticket, or book (where a more specific subject icon wins), it fits tasks specifically about creating, merging, converting, or fixing PDF files. At tiny list sizes, the 'PDF' text can become hard to read and the stacked squares resemble a generic copy icon.
